messages:
jamal: FYI merged PR #4821 a few mins ago, main pipeline turned red on `e2e-matrix` stage. CI link: <https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/321456>
ci-bot: Build 321456 failed: e2e-matrix (linux-gpu) — step 'matrix-run' exit 1
anya: who owns the e2e-matrix job?
leo: pinging @infra-team; I can take a quick look
jamal: failing test looks like `test_matrix_inference_timeout` in `tests/e2e/matrix_test.py`
ci-bot: Recent commit: 9b7f3a2 (authors/jamal) — includes docker bump to `redwood/inference:cuda12-2026-03`
leo: re-running the job now (`/ci rerun 321456`) :gear:
ci-bot: Rerun queued by leo
ci-bot: Rerun started
ci-bot: Rerun finished — still failing
anya: paste of last 20 lines:
```
ERROR: Timeout waiting for worker startup (after 60s)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/e2e/runner.py", line 214, in <module>
    run_matrix()
  File "tests/e2e/runner.py", line 88, in run_matrix
    client.wait_ready(timeout=60)
TimeoutError: worker did not become ready
```
jamal: that log looks like docker image pull or container init stalled — we saw flaky network pulls earlier today in staging
leo: can we check node allocs? @sre-oncall can you confirm if there's a node OOM or network blip around 2072108600-2072108800
sre-oncall: Checking node metrics now, looks like one worker had `docker pull` failures due to registry throttling, sending pod logs
sre-oncall: pod logs snippet:
```
WARN: backoff pulling image redwood/inference:cuda12-2026-03
error: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection error: Resource temporarily unavailable
```
anya: ok, plan: 1) switch e2e job to use `redwood/inference:cuda12-stable` image (hotfix) 2) re-run matrix 3) if green, revert image bump in PR 4821
jamal: +1, I'll open quick revert PR and a patch to pin stable image in CI job
leo: I'm going to cancel remaining queued runs to avoid hammering registry
ci-bot: Job cancelled by leo
sre-oncall: Redeploying registry mirror to CI nodes, should reduce pulls
jamal: thanks all — assigning to leo to validate after mirror
leo: will follow up in ~15m with status :clock1:
ci-bot: New run started after mirror setup
ci-bot: New run succeeded — e2e-matrix green
jamal: great, merging revert PR and will follow up on infra ticket about registry rate limits
anya: filing the infra ticket now (INFRA-319) and noting flaky pattern
jamal: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
